results: For m>=3, U_m is all labeled simple 2-regular graphs on 2m vertices with girth>=m. Both isomorphism types require exactly m positive edge observations.
All m-edge certificates for C_(2m) are m consecutive edges, plus either perfect matching when m is odd; counts 2m or 2m+2.
C_(2m) exact-label minimum is 2m-2; two C_m exact-label minimum is 2m-2 for m>=4, but 3 when m=3.
C8 has inclusion-minimal certificates of both 4 and 5 edges, eight of each; inclusion-minimal does not imply cardinality minimum.
C8/2C4 positive edge closure violates the matroid exchange axiom in a consistent candidate set.
Positive conjunction dictionaries preserving primitive properties and charging real expanded leaf cost preserve optimal certificate cost; free unit-cost names may collapse property counts.
